description:
Kwon Yeong had passed the highest imperial examination at a young age and was dreaming of a brilliant future. Suddenly, he manifests as a ‘Yin’ being (Omega), and everything comes crashing down.

Just as Yeong is about to be sold off as the concubine of some old lecher or the wife of a butcher, a marriage proposal arrives one day from Hwan, his closest friend and mischievous companion…

*“I’ll even address you as ‘husband’! I’ll just be your wife, won’t I!”* *(Source: RIDI, translated)*
